public_payload.normalized_proposition: Sora is at best a semi-reliable guide to how the world looks.

statement.excerpt: It is at best a semi-reliable guide to how the world looks.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that visible anatomical, spatial and temporal errors occur often enough to limit Sora's dependability at depicting ordinary appearances.
Semi-reliable is qualitative; do not convert it into a 50 percent success rate.
The target is the original preview model. Use February 2024, the most recent complete month before publication, for this ongoing observation.
At best expresses an asserted ceiling, not a conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: A representative evaluation of the original model finds substantial recurring visible errors across ordinary subjects and scenes, sufficient to establish limited visual dependability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative evaluation finds consistently convincing anatomy, spatial appearance and temporal continuity across ordinary subjects and scenes, with only uncommon defects.

evidence.explanation: The researchers found strong geometric consistency in ten publicly available Sora clips compared with competing generators. This qualifies a broad dismissal of visual quality, but selected demos and a geometry measure cannot establish overall visual reliability.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: An independently assessed, representative sample from the original preview model, with separate rates for anatomical, spatial and temporal appearance errors and results robust to reasonable readings of semi-reliable.
